hero.intro: This is my personal website: a home for my open-source projects, programming experiments, research and writing. Start with the projects below, or browse the source on GitHub.

about_paragraphs: I started planning this website in April 2026 and created its current repository in September. It is where I keep a record of my work and share what I learn along the way.

My projects range from developer tools and programming languages to desktop software, Android applications and games. The project pages link to the repositories, where you can follow their development.
